title: Specify soft-body/soft-body system modes
scope: Define surface contact and distinct volumes; retain unsupported capability states until implementation.
acceptance: Separate self and inter-system behavior with measurable physical criteria.
Split missing operators and their public-API qualification into new leaf tasks.
evidence: PASS: docs/INTERACTION-MODES.md distinguishes self and separate-system soft-body contact and defines closed bound surfaces, swept vertex-triangle/edge-edge contact, topology exclusions, separation and conservation limits.
PASS: P1-25 through P1-30 separate typed API scopes, bounded surface contact generation, self solve, inter-system solve, portable scheduling and per-driver qualification.
PASS: python3 tools/reference/build.py --check-generated; public headers and generated specification remain consistent.
PASS: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/roadmap -p 'test_*.py'; 19 roadmap/lease tests passed.
PASS: ctest --test-dir build-foundations -R '(generated-api-check|interaction-capability|graph-validation)' --output-on-failure; 3/3 passed and soft-body self/inter capabilities remain unadvertised.
REVIEW: API 0.2 has no soft-body pair edge or self-contact control; open/non-manifold skins, inversion prevention, merging and both exact capability scopes remain unsupported.
